Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset: ONE new BATTLE illustration for dimaher_d, a visibly ADULT woman gladiator, Jack O Nine Tails game cutscene. Full opaque 4:3 landscape scene, target795x596.
Reference roles: Image1 is the original adult character design and weapon reference. Image2 is her portrait for face/identity. Image3 is the approved crowded colosseum environment. Image4 defines the hand-painted fantasy illustration medium only, not its room.
Preserve this exact adult character: long flowing pale golden-blonde hair, amber-gold eyes, blue crystalline wing-like hair ornaments, high blue collar and red rectangular jewel, white-and-gold fitted fantasy gladiator outfit with the same existing coverage, blue scale-patterned long forearm armor, blue scale hip and leg armor plates with gold trim and red jewels. Keep her body proportions and all identifying design. Do not add helmets, shields, animal ears, capes or clothing changes. Her weapons are exactly TWO matching ornate short curved BLUE blades with large antique-gold dragon-shaped guards and ruby-red gems, as in reference1; one firmly held by its actual handle in each hand, not extra swords or axes.
Scene: sunlit worn sand inside a crowded grand pale-stone colosseum. Tall curved tiers packed with distant spectators and purple banners, dusty warm daylight and cooler reflected shadows. The same paint handling, light direction, perspective and warm sand color bounce must unify the figure, weapons and arena. No pasted cutout or blank studio background. Human-sized adult against large architecture.
Action: a fierce grounded dual-blade combat maneuver: knees bent, torso twisting in an agile step, one curved blue dagger crossing in a defensive guard and the other drawn back for a close slash. Both arms and hands readable and naturally connected, two weapons separated in space, natural thumb-and-finger grips. Hair and narrow costume panels move with momentum. Focused tense face and clenched determination, gaze toward the unseen opponent rather than a beauty pose or camera portrait. Frame from head through the knees; lower legs can naturally continue beyond the bottom edge as in the original, but no isolated transparent cutoff and keep both full blades within the frame. Ground perspective and cast shadows must make the action believable.
Style: serious polished hand-painted fantasy game art, readable anime-influenced anatomy and face, controlled brush planes and natural selective edges. Not a photograph, glossy plastic CGI, blurry smudging or pixel mosaic. Some dust on the blue scales and white fabric, a few small superficial battle scratches, a restrained blood trace on one blade. Preserve existing clothing coverage and do not sexualize the composition. No exposed internal anatomy, dismemberment, text, border, UI or watermark. Opaque to every edge.

metadata.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset: ONE finished DEFEAT cutscene of the same visibly ADULT woman gladiator dimaher_d, complete opaque landscape4:3, target795x596.
Image1 is the selected battle illustration. Lock her adult face, long pale golden-blonde loose hair, amber-gold eyes, TWO blue crystalline hair ornaments, blue high collar with rectangular red jewel, white-and-gold fitted fantasy gladiator outfit, blue scale forearm and leg/hip armor with gold trim, all existing coverage, and the exact TWO blue curved short blades with ornate gold guards and ruby gems. Image2 is the original identity/equipment reference only. Preserve the same sunlit pale-stone colosseum with dense spectators, purple banners, dusty golden sand, warm side light and hand-painted game-art style.
Change action, camera and posture into a genuinely defeated collapse, not a neutral model lying attractively on the floor. She has fallen heavily on her back at a diagonal, one shoulder rolled partly to the side; her shoulders, upper back and head are fully carried by the sand. Her spine is slack and body is not arched. Long hair lies spread messily under her head and along the ground, blue ornaments remain recognizable. Her head turns away from the viewer and tilts toward the sky with a clear side profile, eyebrows drawn upward in pain, eyes squeezed shut or barely open staring upward, parted lips and a strained trembling grimace. Show exhaustion, hurt and despair, not calmness, confidence, a smirk, or direct camera eye contact.
One arm has dropped out to the side with open slack fingers, the other arm lies limp beside the waist; both hands are empty. Both matching blue daggers have fallen onto the arena sand separately within view, near her slack hands, exactly two weapons total. Bent weak knees and legs are supported by the ground and turned naturally to one side; armor and limbs connect anatomically. Lower legs can naturally extend beyond the canvas as the original lower legs are not specified; never invent boots or expose additional body. Use a slightly raised three-quarter view that reads her whole collapsed weight and the separated weapons, with some open sand and distant arena visible. No lounging on an elbow, no held-up portrait head, no pinup arch or posed symmetry.
Show a serious cold-weapon defeat: distinct superficial cuts and blood streaks on upper arm and cheek, blood smears on blue forearm armor, blood on both blade edges, a modest dark-red stain absorbed into the sand under the dropped arm, scuffed and chipped blue scales and small local tears at existing cloth edges without reducing coverage. Dust and sand adhere to hair, armor and skin where she hit the floor. Clear injury at game size but no exposed organs, no internal anatomy, no severed limbs or excessive close-up gore. She is defeated and unable to continue fighting, not an execution scene.
Repaint the body and arena as one coherent hand-painted fantasy illustration, using shared perspective, matched directional light, warm ground bounce and dense contact shadows under her head, shoulders, hair, armor, knees and daggers. Serious anime-influenced face/anatomy with controlled visible paint planes and readable details, no photorealism or glossy plastic CGI, no pixel-smudge blur, no pasted sprite. No text, border, UI or watermark; opaque to every edge.
